description: Jet displayed at the Sport Club do Recife headquarters in Ilha do Retiro. Sources conflict on identity: ABRAPAC (2019) lists it as F-80C FAB 4215, while the Feb 2026 survivors compilation lists AT-33A FAB 4315 - the two-seat T-33 identification is followed here pending an on-site check. Club grounds; ask at the gate.
museum_name: Sport Club do Recife Jet Monument, Recife
